entities.summary: Drew Edward VerHagen is an American professional baseball pitcher for the NC Dinos of the KBO League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers and St. Louis Cardinals, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters.
